name: Query activity
description: Who runs queries, the most frequent query patterns and the queries that failed, filtered by user.

dashboard.name: Query activity
dashboard.description: Query activity from system.query_log, filtered by user.

variables.name: user
variables.label: User
variables.query: SELECT DISTINCT user FROM system.query_log WHERE event_date >= today() - 7 ORDER BY user

panels.name: Queries over time
panels.query:
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL $bucket second) AS ts,
  countIf(type = 'QueryFinish') AS finished,
  countIf(type != 'QueryFinish') AS failed
FROM system.query_log
WHERE type != 'QueryStart'
  AND $__timeFilter(event_time, datetime)
  AND user IN (${user})
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts WITH FILL
  FROM toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(intDiv($__timeFrom, 1000)), INTERVAL $bucket second)
  TO toDateTime(intDiv($__timeTo, 1000))
  STEP $bucket

panels.name: Top users
panels.query:
SELECT
  user,
  count() AS queries,
  countIf(type != 'QueryFinish') AS failed
FROM system.query_log
WHERE type != 'QueryStart'
  AND $__timeFilter(event_time, datetime)
  AND user IN (${user})
GROUP BY user
ORDER BY queries DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.name: Top users by time and data
panels.query:
SELECT
  user,
  count() AS queries,
  round(sum(query_duration_ms) / 1000, 1) AS total_s,
  formatReadableSize(sum(read_bytes)) AS read,
  formatReadableSize(max(memory_usage)) AS peak_memory
FROM system.query_log
WHERE type != 'QueryStart'
  AND $__timeFilter(event_time, datetime)
  AND user IN (${user})
GROUP BY user
ORDER BY total_s DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.name: Top query patterns
panels.description: Queries grouped by normalized_query_hash: the same query with different literals counts as one pattern.
panels.query:
SELECT
  toString(normalized_query_hash) AS pattern,
  count() AS runs,
  round(avg(query_duration_ms), 1) AS avg_ms,
  round(quantile(0.95)(query_duration_ms), 1) AS p95_ms,
  formatReadableSize(sum(read_bytes)) AS read,
  left(normalizeQuery(any(query)), 200) AS sample
FROM system.query_log
WHERE type = 'QueryFinish'
  AND $__timeFilter(event_time, datetime)
  AND user IN (${user})
GROUP BY normalized_query_hash
ORDER BY runs DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.name: Failed queries
panels.query:
SELECT
  event_time,
  user,
  exception_code,
  type,
  left(exception, 200) AS error,
  left(query, 200) AS query
FROM system.query_log
WHERE type IN ('ExceptionBeforeStart', 'ExceptionWhileProcessing')
  AND $__timeFilter(event_time, datetime)
  AND user IN (${user})
ORDER BY event_time DESC
LIMIT 100
